"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import ast
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH = 60
+_ALLOWED_FORMULA_CHARS = frozenset("0123456789idn+-*/()")
+_ALLOWED_NAMES = frozenset({"id", "n"})
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _validate_node(node: ast.AST) -> None:
+    """Raise ValueError unless the node belongs to the allowed scoring grammar."""
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Expression):
+        _validate_node(node.body)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
+        if not isinstance(node.op, (ast.Add, ast.Sub, ast.Mult, ast.FloorDiv)):
+            raise ValueError("operator not allowed")
+        _validate_node(node.left)
+        _validate_node(node.right)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        if not isinstance(node.op, ast.USub):
+            raise ValueError("operator not allowed")
+        _validate_node(node.operand)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        if isinstance(node.value, bool) or not isinstance(node.value, int) or node.value < 0:
+            raise ValueError("constant not allowed")
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        if node.id not in _ALLOWED_NAMES:
+            raise ValueError("name not allowed")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("expression not allowed")
+
+
+def _parse_formula(formula: object) -> ast.Expression | None:
+    """Return a validated AST for formula, or None when it is not valid."""
+    if not isinstance(formula, str) or len(formula) > _MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH:
+        return None
+    if any(char not in _ALLOWED_FORMULA_CHARS and not char.isspace() for char in formula):
+        return None
+    try:
+        tree = ast.parse(formula, mode="eval")
+        _validate_node(tree)
+    except (SyntaxError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    return tree
+
+
+def _evaluate(node: ast.AST, variables: dict) -> int:
+    if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
+        left = _evaluate(node.left, variables)
+        right = _evaluate(node.right, variables)
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
+            return left + right
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub):
+            return left - right
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult):
+            return left * right
+        return left // right
+    if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        return -_evaluate(node.operand, variables)
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        return node.value
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        return variables[node.id]
+    raise ValueError("unsupported expression")
+
+
+def handle_rank_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    tree = _parse_formula(params.get("formula"))
+    if tree is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+    ranked = []
+    for user in users.list_users():
+        variables = {"id": user["id"], "n": len(user["name"])}
+        try:
+            score = _evaluate(tree.body, variables)
+        except ZeroDivisionError:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+        ranked.append({"id": user["id"], "name": user["name"], "score": score})
+    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item["score"], item["id"]))
+    return 200, {"users": ranked}

from app.api.handlers import handle_rank_users as h

# valid
print(h({"formula": "id * 10 + n"}))
print(h({"formula": "n - id"}))
print(h({"formula": "-(id) // 2"}))
print(h({"formula": "5"}))

# invalid
cases = [
    {},
    {"formula": None},
    {"formula": 5},
    {"formula": "a" * 61},
    {"formula": "id // 0"},
    {"formula": "id / 2"},
    {"formula": "id ** 2"},
    {"formula": "__import__('os').system('echo hi')"},
    {"formula": "id if n else 0"},
    {"formula": "1_000"},
    {"formula": "+id"},
    {"formula": "id.n"},
    {"formula": ""},
    {"formula": "   "},
    {"formula": "id @ n"},
    {"formula": "lambda: 1"},
    {"formula": "id and n"},
]
for c in cases:
    r = h(c)
    assert r[0] == 400 and r[1] == {"error": "invalid formula"}, (c, r)
print("invalid cases OK")

# length boundary: 60 ok, 61 bad
f60 = "1" * 60
assert h({"formula": f60})[0] == 200
assert h({"formula": "1" * 61})[0] == 400
print("length boundary OK")

# tie-break check
status, body = h({"formula": "0"})
print(body)
assert [u["id"] for u in body["users"]] == [1, 2, 3]

# descending order
status, body = h({"formula": "id"})
assert [u["id"] for u in body["users"]] == [3, 2, 1]
print("ordering OK")
PY

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import ast
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH = 60
+_ALLOWED_FORMULA_CHARS = frozenset("0123456789idn+-*/()")
+_ALLOWED_NAMES = frozenset({"id", "n"})
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _validate_node(node: ast.AST) -> None:
+    """Raise ValueError unless the node belongs to the allowed scoring grammar."""
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Expression):
+        _validate_node(node.body)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
+        if not isinstance(node.op, (ast.Add, ast.Sub, ast.Mult, ast.FloorDiv)):
+            raise ValueError("operator not allowed")
+        _validate_node(node.left)
+        _validate_node(node.right)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        if not isinstance(node.op, ast.USub):
+            raise ValueError("operator not allowed")
+        _validate_node(node.operand)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        if isinstance(node.value, bool) or not isinstance(node.value, int) or node.value < 0:
+            raise ValueError("constant not allowed")
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        if node.id not in _ALLOWED_NAMES:
+            raise ValueError("name not allowed")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("expression not allowed")
+
+
+def _parse_formula(formula: object) -> ast.Expression | None:
+    """Return a validated AST for formula, or None when it is not valid."""
+    if not isinstance(formula, str) or len(formula) > _MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH:
+        return None
+    if any(char not in _ALLOWED_FORMULA_CHARS and not char.isspace() for char in formula):
+        return None
+    try:
+        tree = ast.parse(formula, mode="eval")
+        _validate_node(tree)
+    except (SyntaxError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    return tree
+
+
+def _evaluate(node: ast.AST, variables: dict) -> int:
+    if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
+        left = _evaluate(node.left, variables)
+        right = _evaluate(node.right, variables)
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
+            return left + right
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub):
+            return left - right
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult):
+            return left * right
+        return left // right
+    if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        return -_evaluate(node.operand, variables)
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        return node.value
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        return variables[node.id]
+    raise ValueError("unsupported expression")
+
+
+def handle_rank_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    tree = _parse_formula(params.get("formula"))
+    if tree is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+    ranked = []
+    for user in users.list_users():
+        variables = {"id": user["id"], "n": len(user["name"])}
+        try:
+            score = _evaluate(tree.body, variables)
+        except ZeroDivisionError:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+        ranked.append({"id": user["id"], "name": user["name"], "score": score})
+    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item["score"], item["id"]))
+    return 200, {"users": ranked}
